title: Matt Damon Sweats From His Scalp While Eating Spicy Wings | Hot Ones
summary: Matt Damon appears on Hot Ones, eating progressively spicier wings while discussing his film career and promoting Stillwater. He also explains how the decline of the DVD market changed which movies get made.
why: Cited as the source for Damon's explanation that the DVD market's collapse killed mid-budget movies, in threads on Hollywood economics.

quote.text: According to Matt Damon[1], it's the obsolescence of the DVD market that changed the calculus of mid-budget films.
